summary: Corrected README env-var references from ALGOLIA_APPID to ALGOLIA_APPLICATION_ID in the MCP config and environment table.
reason: The generated README used the template-var-derived env name ALGOLIA_APPID, but the CLI reads ALGOLIA_APPLICATION_ID; users following the MCP setup would have misconfigured credentials.
validated_outcome: README env table, MCP config, and auth narrative all reference ALGOLIA_APPLICATION_ID consistently.
